---
title: "result"
output: html_document
---

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(data.table)
```

```{r}
path <- '~/project_data/downy/result'
list.files(path, pattern = 'csv', full.names = TRUE, recursive = TRUE) %>% 
  map_dfr(function(x) {
    data <- fread(x, header = TRUE, sep = ',') %>% as.data.frame()
    data$confidence.score <- basename(dirname(x))
    data$sample <- basename(x) %>% str_replace('.csv', '') %>% str_replace('_cleaned_','.')
    return(data)
  })
```
